category: map tiles, place search and reverse geocoding API with no key

free_tier.stated: no plan and no quota to keep under: OpenStreetMap vector tiles for the whole planet (zoom 0 to 14), five MapLibre styles, place search and reverse geocoding endpoints, with no API key, sign-up, token, domain allow-list or card; fair use applies, and bulk downloads and scraping the whole planet will be blocked
free_tier.notes: free means best effort: there is no contract or uptime guarantee; the OpenStreetMap attribution that the styles carry must stay in place

per_object_cap.stated: one query a request for search and reverse; an empty tile is an HTTP 204; no batch endpoint is listed, and bulk downloads and scraping the whole planet will be blocked

retention.stated: unverified: no rule for storing search or reverse results is stated on the page

egress.terms: no usage tiers and no invoice; tiles are cached at the edge by a CDN and no byte metering is stated

interface_detail: HTTPS GET with CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin *): MapLibre style JSON at tiles.waymorphic.com/styles/{positron,bright,liberty,dark,fiord}, TileJSON at /planet, vector tiles at /planet/{version}/{z}/{x}/{y}.pbf, place search at /search?q=, address lookup at /reverse?lat=&lon=, and one place at /lookup/{id}; keyless search and reverse calls answered HTTP 200 with GeoJSON
tooling: any HTTP client; MapLibre, Leaflet and QGIS read the tiles; an OpenAPI description of the tile endpoints is published
chaining: keyless vector tiles, place search and reverse geocoding with no account, for prototypes and production maps; best effort with no contract or uptime guarantee, and no stated rule for storing results

limits.value: unverified: no numeric rate limit or quota is published; fair use applies and bulk downloads and whole-planet scraping will be blocked

binding_note: no quota exists, so the blocking of bulk use under fair use is the only stated ceiling

identity_cost.detail: no sign-up, no key, no token, no domain allow-list and no card; keyless search and reverse calls answered HTTP 200

reliability_note: best effort on a small server and a global CDN with no contract or uptime guarantee; bulk downloads and whole-planet scraping will be blocked
confidence_note: the home page, which also serves as the API reference, was quoted on 2026-11-02, and keyless search and reverse calls answered HTTP 200 with GeoJSON. The request volume at which fair use blocks was not tested, and no storage rule for results is stated.
